page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance offers 192 dedicated virtual CPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:2 ratio of vCPU to memory with 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local disk storage or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, while complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

With a 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, resource allocation focuses on parallel execution rather than memory buffers. Core density across 192 dedicated cores maximizes processing throughput for CPU-bound tasks, providing efficient scaling for compute workloads without paying for unused memory or local storage. However, applications requiring persistent local storage or large memory capacity require external cloud block storage or alternative instance families. Suitable workloads include continuous integration pipelines, batch data processing, high-volume web serving, and scientific simulations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is a high-density, compute-optimized cloud server instance powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T24 processor operating at 2.7 GHz under a KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 384.0 GB of memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 2.0 GB of memory per core. The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps but does not include local storage disks or GPU hardware accelerators. Designed for high multi-threaded performance, the hardware profile offers cost efficiency by maximizing compute core density relative to memory allocation. The absence of local disk storage means operational data relies on attached network storage solutions. This instance configuration is well-aligned with intensive compute workloads, including parallel batch processing, software compilation pipelines, web server fleets, financial modeling, and engineering simulations that demand substantial parallel CPU capacity.
